description: End an OpenTrain contract only after every milestone is terminal. Unfunded drafts must be deleted/cancelled; funded, pending-approval, review-required, or refund-in-progress milestones return a 409 with each blocking milestone, amount, state, and required next action. Completed, cancelled, and successfully refunded milestones do not block. Requires payments:write scope, a claimed account, and the payments-write feature flag.
name: opentrain_end_contract
